name: Data.det_heckeOnGood_eq
summary: Equal traces of all powers give equal characteristic polynomials (S empty in charpoly_eq_mul_of_trace_pow_add), hence equal determinants.

steps.claim: Write each determinant as the determinant of the matrix in a basis of the good forms, that is, the product of the roots of its characteristic polynomial.
steps.lean:
simp [← det_toMatrix (finBasis ℂ (D.goodForms V)),
    ← det_toMatrix (finBasis ℂ (D.goodForms V')), det_eq_prod_roots_charpoly]

steps.claim: It suffices that the two characteristic polynomials are equal, and for that (characteristic 0, algebraically closed) that tr(A^m) = tr(B^m) for every m >= 0; the case m = 0 is the equality of the dimensions of the two spaces of good forms, which are not assumed equal.
The m-th power of the matrix of heckeOnGood(D, V)(p) is the matrix of heckeOnGood(D, V)(p^m) (a monoid homomorphism), and its trace equals that for V' by trace_heckeOnGood_eq applied to p^m.
steps.lean: simp [toMatrix_pow, ← trace_eq_matrix_trace, ← map_pow, D.trace_heckeOnGood_eq o o']
